d: Charms an enemy hero into striking one of its own allies (3 mana).

spell.h: (an enemy hero within 2), then a unit it can hit that is not yours.
spell.p2: Now tap the unit it must attack (violet).
spell.d: charm a non-boss enemy hero within 2, then pick a unit it could hit right now that is not yours: it attacks at once, with its own splash, stun, burn and drain, and its mana cost is waived. Kills pay you. It cannot counterattack until its next turn.
